title: This is Tulsa 2025 #theoutsidersmusical #nationaltour #theatrereview
transcript: what if we just drive to Tulsa it's only like 10 hours away making a quick pit stop in Guthrie Oklahoma yes we made it from the last row of the mezzanine right before curtain they bring Ponyboy on stage song just got out of the outsiders tour here in Tulsa and you know what it works so well on tour so well I was sitting in literally the last row of the mezzanine uh there was another level above me but even from that far away the visuals just look so good on a stage I think this works really well in a large theater space the tour cast sounds absolutely incredible the harmonies were just uh the harmonies in throwin in the towel the harmonies in stay gold fantastic fantastic and yes there is rain uh no pyro but the way that they do the pyro effects for the tour version translates really well to this stage I think ultimately all of my criticisms of uh outsiders as a show still remain like I think some of the writing is a little clunky and some of that I do think is intentional and is part of the source material but I think the way that this has translated and is staged is gorgeous absolutely gorgeous and uh yeah I'm really glad I got to see this totally worth the 10 hour drive now as far as tickets go I did buy a full price ticket for this because this is the Tulsa run uh and the run is basically entirely sold out here uh for obvious reasons with the exception of like there were two tickets left for today's Friday matinee so that is that is what we went with uh but you know what worth it worth and if you are coming to Tulsa this weekend to go see it you can also check out the Outsiders House Museum which I saw today which is really cool and kind of a great companion piece to getting to see the musical
classificationReason: Review of The Outsiders musical on national tour in Tulsa - creator saw the touring production, not the current Broadway production
